top_concerns: No analysis of pattern-aware or spoofing adversaries; the fixed periodic pattern is easy to learn and pattern-preserving edits (e.g. even-length deletions for AB) are invisible
Evaluation is synthetic: random 1-6 token edits on 64-token texts, small models, beam search; no paraphrase, human edits, multiple edits or longer texts
Weak or ill-posed baselines (KGW/Unigram forced into an AA pattern with w=2); no scan-statistic/LLR, HC or segment-level comparison
Lenient metrics: per-position Type-I 0.1, tolerance L=3, no precision/recall or text-level false positive rate, no error bars
Thin theory (Janson bound with unknown mu, no miss-detection guarantee) and the longer pattern worsens the PPL/detectability trade-off
